description: Quote existing host-authored video variants for review. In this host, prepare with soclo_host_plan_prepare, read every selected guide and author N distinct hooks/storyboards using the host user’s usage; import_selected each exact owned photo/actor/version plan, using existing Create photos-to-video and saved actors. This quotes those saved revisions and shows the total and an estimated balance after; it never calls a Soclo-funded planner, spends nothing and sends no Make. Each variant is a separate full re-film that needs its own exact approval with soclo_video_variants_approve. If any variant has an UNKNOWN outcome, read it with soclo_video_variants_status first. Persist all returned IDs in host context/widget state. One result is one finished Soclo render, never joined agent-local clips. Wallet/ledger and soclo_video_make remain authoritative. Take pacing and takePlan come from host-selected skills, never batch constants.
